AzureCostAndUsageModel.description:
Azure Cost & Usage configuration.
AccountType is declared here alongside BillingScope and scope-specific fields.

BillingScope rules (validated in OnboardingCreateRequest):
    - EA  (any scope)    : EnrollmentId (optional)
    - MCA Billing Account: no extra fields required
    - MCA Billing Profile: BillingProfileIds (required list)
    - MCA Invoice        : InvoiceSectionIds (required list)
    - CSP Billing Account: no extra fields required
    - CSP Billing Profile: BillingProfileIds (required list)
    - CSP Customer Tenant: CustomerTenantId (required)

Always optional:
    - ActualExportUrl, AmortizedExportUrl, EffectiveFrom

BillingProfileIds.description: Billing Profile IDs - required for MCA or CSP + Billing Profile scope.
BillingProfileIds.title: Billingprofileids

BillingScope.description: Billing scope. Required for MCA ('Billing Account', 'Billing Profile', 'Invoice') and CSP ('Billing Account', 'Billing Profile', 'Customer Tenant') account types.
BillingScope.title: Billingscope

CustomerTenantId.description: Customer Tenant ID - required for CSP + Customer Tenant scope.
CustomerTenantId.title: Customertenantid

EnrollmentId.description: Enrollment ID - applicable for EA account type.
EnrollmentId.title: Enrollmentid

InvoiceSectionIds.description: Invoice IDs - required for MCA + Invoice scope.
InvoiceSectionIds.title: Invoicesectionids

info.description:
Data Inventory Services APIs enable management and tracking of data collection schedules.

## Overview

Data Inventory services provide APIs for managing the lifecycle of data collection and processing tasks. The service 
orchestrates scheduled and on-demand data gathering operations across multiple cloud providers and external systems.

## Services

### Onboarding Service
Handles creation, update, and deletion of cloud connectors across supported cloud providers.

### Connector Service
Provides listing and count of enrolled cloud connectors, grouped by provider and onboarding type. It also providers 
details of each connector, including onboarding status and last successful data collection time.

Note - 'Connector Service' APIs are deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Please use the new APIs under
`Unified Onboarding`.
